top_signals.title: Procter & Gamble will acquire supplements brand Thorne, CEO tells CNBC
top_signals.summary: P&G CEO Shailesh Jejurikar said the acquisition is play to grow the company's health business on CNBC's "Squawk on the Street."

top_signals.title: Alfortish Joins McDonough Marine asDirector of Maintenance
top_signals.summary: McDonough Marine said that Michael Alfortish has joined the company as its Director of Maintenance. Alfortish brings more than 14 years of experience in the marine industry, holding key leadership roles in both shipyard and marine transportation operations.
